answer: Each new AI on PoA must submit a proof‑of‑work based on a unique environmental hash, e.g., a tundra‑noise seed combined with a juniper‑shaped Merkle root and an island timestamp. Verifiers recompute the hash; recreating it requires the full work for every identity, so a Sybil attacker must spend that cost per clone. Since referral rewards pay zero for mismatched links, the attacker gains nothing while paying the full proof‑of‑work price.
